label: Electroacupuncture as an eosinophil-targeting treatment in ovalbumin-induced allergic rhinitis involving β
summary: Eosinophils amplify type-2 (Th2) inflammation and tissue injury in allergic rhinitis (AR), and eosinophilic burden correlates with disease severity and future asthma risk. Current AR therapies have limitations, motivating interest in non-pharmacologic neuromodulatory approaches. Here, we tested whether electroacupuncture (EA) attenuates eosinophilic inflammation in AR and probed a candidate neuroimmune mechanism.
